::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 26th 1896  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/17
:::

Dear [Mr Holgate](people/person_1643.qmd)[^1]
I will try what I can do.  I did write a short [memoir](cmy_books/cmybook_66.qmd) of Lord Seaton in the Christian Remembrancer, and it has all the dates. If I can find it, I can easily do what you wish. How soon will it be wanted?

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Clifford Wyndham Holgate (1859-1903) was the author of a number of works on the history of Winchester College;  this correspondence seems to relate to a proposed article on Lord Seaton, perhaps to be published in the school magazine?
